project.name: ETF & Fund Screen
project.goal: Screen the US-listed ETF universe and hand me a shortlist of at most twelve funds for a long-term core allocation, with the reasoning attached, within three weeks. Screen on total cost of ownership rather than headline expense ratio (fee, tracking difference against the stated index, bid-ask spread at typical size, securities-lending revenue returned), on liquidity that survives a bad week, on structure (physical or synthetic, domicile, tax treatment, lending policy), and on holdings overlap between candidates — a shortlist of twelve funds that are one bet is a shortlist of one. Every number carries its as-of date and a source. Process the universe in files with code, never by reading rows into context. Say plainly which funds you excluded and why; the exclusions are half the deliverable.
